title: Toronto block — open airborne LiDAR reference

local_axes: height above chosen local ground baseline
vertical_baseline_method: Median ground-class elevation within 20 m of projected map pin
display_sampling: Uniform deterministic sample without replacement; seed 20261027; excludes noise classes 7 and 18
display_coloring: Class colours; source contains no RGB imagery
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. LiDAR: Toronto and Region Conservation Authority, distributed by Natural Resources Canada (CanElevation), GTA_2023 project.
limitations: The 2023 reference may differ from the site shown in the provided video; the video's actual recording date is unverified.
Airborne sampling is strongest on roofs and ground; vertical and occluded surfaces may be sparse.
The geographic map pin identifies the area; no metric transform from the video model has been established.
The 1 cm coordinate quantization is not a statement of measurement accuracy.
acquisition_date_display: 2023 reference LiDAR; cropped point GPS timestamps indicate 11 April 2023
date_evidence_status: The dates describe different scopes: NRCan filename convention uses project acquisition end date, while per-point GPS timestamps describe the cropped measurements. Thus project-end 2023-05-11 and point date 2023-04-11 are consistent.
